content: Pole ewendi o Serusaleme
Tunokakene nowu, tukesungeme o ningi Kose mu watange, yilumbu ayimadukaange tuketole o ningi Rode. Yilumbu ayimaduke tukewende o ningi Patare.
Tumadale watange djimawendaange o yinange yi Fenisi, tumabwénangeme noyenewende.
Tunolabilile ningi Sipere, tumavyole o maghetu mu wende o yari yi Siri. Tukesikeme o musyengi Tire o watange djimabe na mufune wusunduse.
Tumarasene badukitsi na tumatsane tsone nowu. Banolubusu na Yinyuni Yisyeme, bamaghandise Pole uwende o Serusaleme.
Tumbe tsone eni djinovyoghe, tukebongulile nzile. Djowu botsu bakétuvetsighe, na baghetu na bane, teno dikotulu di musyengi. Tuke kuteme va disimu di mubu nosambile Nyambi.
Tunoghanesene kale mutu, tumanangeme mu watange. Djowu bamaghabughe mu mimbu mowu.
Tumamane disabu dyetu, urambuyile o Tire teno musyengi Tolemayise. Tunomane usimbe baane ba ngudji o musyengi eni, tuketsane nowu yilumbu yimosi.

Yilumbu ayimaduke, tukesogheme notole o musyengi Sesaré. Vane, tukekote o ndaghu Filipe, musamunitsi wu Musamu Wuboti na tuketsane ombu wandi. Amabe wumosi va ghari yisambwali yi batu, abamasolu o Serusaleme mu wamuse bakwili.
Amabe na baane bana ba baghetu bamabe batsyemi, bamabighaange.
Mbé tuke bilumbu bipwele vane, ave mubiyitsi winengulu Aghabise amaruyile o Sudé.

Akebambene netu, akebonge beleti dji Pole, akekétunge makulu na makake na djoni novose yi: «La adi Yinyuni Yisyeme evosi: “Fumu beleti adjidji otungu nane na bivunde bi baSwife ba Serusaleme, mba bomuwakise ombu beni.”»
Tunowulu mane, djetu na baane ba ngudji ba Sesaré tumalende Pole akéwende o Serusaleme.
Tumbe akewake yi: «Mumba yi dililili nondetse manyuru? Nyikunzeme mutungu na muboku o Serusaleme dibandu Fumu Djesu.»
Dibilaange yi tusamarungule umusanze ditase dyandi, tumadunde utsiyise novose yi: «Durondu du Fumu duvaghu.»
Mwa bilumbu binovyoghe, tukekunzeme nomate o Serusaleme.
Badukitsi ba Sesaré bamawende netu, baketutsanise ombu Nasone, mwise Sipere, awumabe mudukitsi vane kale.
Pole eyélabe Sake
Ave tumatolile o Serusaleme, baane ba ngudji bamatusangile na nzangu.
Yilumbu ayimaduke, Pole akewende netu ombu Sake, o bivunde byotsu bi dibundu bimaghukemine.
Pole akebasimbe nobatsingule bikumbu byotsu nane Nzambi amasalile ombu abagha baSwife.
Banomuwulu bakedodise Nzambi. Mba bakevaghe Pole yi: «Wilabi, mwane-ma, tosini kwe tsi baSwife bamasinge Djesu. Djobotsu baname na Mughaghe Moyise.

Yotsu yine la adi bamabatsingule: “Wilongi baSwife botsu abetsani va ghari malongu masusu, yi badundi Mughaghe wu Moyise. Wibatsinguli yi bayamwérebaange baane bowu na bayamwéduke mighulu mi djetu baSwife.”
Tsyé tuvale? Bodjabe yi wumarughe.
Kaboghu, vaghe adi tiwutsinguli. Vave, vadji babaale bane netu batsi leve pesi ombu Nzambi.

Babeyi, djenu botsu yétsyemuswanu va wusu Nzambi. Fute byotsu mumbari bakefughu myuru. Pa dutsivaghe nane, batu botsu bodjabe yi vagha ngenze mu adi batsiwuvosile, tumbe ndewandi wighobisi mughaghe Moyise.
Mu bise malongu abamasinge Djesu, tutsibarendisile mu batsingule yi: bayabwedji banyame atsivaghulu ombu bakosi vo banyame atsighaghewu kingu mu palise malungu, mba bayavaghe bumbembu.»
Yilumbu ayimaduke, Pole akebeghe batu beni babane bakekésyemise djobotsu. Akewende o ndaghu Nzambi notsingule yilumbu ayi bovaghulile paghu na dutsyemusu du mutu-mutu dusukile.
Pole amaghangu o dulombili du ndaghu Nzambi
Yisambwali yi bilumbu mbé yike usuke, ave baSwife ba yari yi Asi bamalabile Pole o dulombili du ndaghu Nzambi. Bakenangule mughungi wotsu, bakemughange,

noghamughe yi: «BaYisrayele, tuwamusyanu! La mutu awilonzi batu botsu mbure tsyotsu dilongi di kondenyonde na mukute Yisrayele, mughaghe etu na mbure djisyeme. Amakotise ne abagha baSwife mu mbure édjidji na bamadjibivise.»

Pa bamadisalise, mbari bilumbu abiteghe bamalabe Torfime mwise Yifese djone Pole bamayenewendaange mu musyengi Serusaleme. Bamasingene yi Pole amamukotise o dulombili du baSwife, tumbe bamabe na mbele.
Dimbunge dikelave mu musyengi wotsu, mba batu bakepalile yari na yari na bakeghukeme. Batu bakeghange Pole, nomupalise o dulombili du ndaghu Nzambi, adji bamalenge nobindighe dikotulu.
Mbé baronde uboke Pole, mu temu eni abemoyi bamayétsingule yivunde yi baghore ba Rome, yi Serusaleme djotsu ukunge djikungi.
Vane-vane yivunde akebonge baghore na bivunde byowu, nowende mbangu o mughungi. Banolabe yivunde, bakedunde udimbe Pole.
Yivunde akebambene nandi, akemughangise nomutungise na pange bedji. Mba akewivulu dine dyandi na dyambu adi amavaghe.
Tumbe mu mughungi, abéba bamaghamughaange didi, bane bamaghamughaange disusu. Yivunde mbé aghorungule ughangise dyambu na tsikiri dibandu nkumfu. Akeveghe dirume dyubeghe Pole o ndaghu baghore.
Pole anotole vo bande yikadi, baghore bakemunangule, dibandu dikani di mughungi.
Mumba batu bapwele bamamudukaange, noghamughe yi: «Afu!»
Pole ekeghanze va wusu mughungi baSwife
Ave bamakotisilaange Pole o ndaghu baghore, akevaghe yivunde yi: «Nine musughe uvose mwa dyambu?» Yivunde amasutu, nomuwivule yi: «Widjabi uvose mbembu baNgereke?
Kaboghu wughaa mwise Yisipete awumarombise didjunge, nobeghe tosini-djina (4 000) tsi batu na bitoghulu byowu o kumu dji ghumughe?»
Pole amawaghule yi: «Menu muSwife, uburulu o Tarese dji Silisi, mutsighe musyengi awughélibunu. Kokolu tsyaghu, singe ngavose na mughungi.»
Yivunde akemusingile dyoni. Pole, diteli va djulu yikadi, akesambe dikake ombu mughungi mudile duvotsu. Botsu bakevole «swii», mba akebavosile mu mbembu baEberu.
